title: Shortcuts: refuse chords with no modifier and compare folded Control chords (Fable review F1+F4)
description: Fable review docs/agent-work/2026-10-28-ui-wave-3/FABLE-REVIEW.md F1 and F4. Settings > Shortcuts records a chord with no Cmd/Ctrl/Alt (a bare letter, Enter, Space, Backspace, Tab, arrows, Shift+letter); afterwards every press of that key fires the action and never reaches the document (probe: Save recorded as G, typing gag gives a). Fix in src/shortcuts/store.ts chordProblem(): require at least one of meta/ctrl/alt (function keys may be the one exception, decide and document), and compare the folded chord (Ctrl treated as Cmd, as resolveChord does) so a Ctrl+S override for New section is refused as taken by Save instead of being accepted and shadowed. Add fail-first cases to src/shortcuts/shortcuts.test.ts and one Playwright case in tests/shortcuts.spec.ts (press Change then a bare letter: status says why, chord unchanged). Update the Shortcuts paragraph in docs/design-system.md only via a DESIGN DOC note. Evidence of the defect: node_modules/.cache/personal-word-beta/ui3-fable-review/probe.log and shadow.test.ts.

handoff.text: Core fix is good: tsc 0, vitest src/shortcuts 14/14 on my rerun; fail-first log shows 2 red before fix; message 'Add Command, Control or Option to that shortcut.' is clear; Ctrl+S for New section now refused as taken by Save; Ctrl+C reserved; no default chord is refused (all defaults have Cmd; Shift+Enter is read-only and not recordable, any user attempt at it gets the modifier message). GAP: readShortcuts in src/shortcuts/store.ts still keeps any stored override that isChord accepts, so a previously stored bare chord (e.g. Save = g, the F1 probe state) or a stored Ctrl duplicate still loads and keeps shadowing typing after this fix. Required behaviour: stored overrides that are now invalid must be dropped on read. Fix: in readShortcuts skip a value when it has no meta/ctrl/alt and is not F1-F12 (reuse the same check as chordProblem), add a vitest case with memory('{"save":{"key":"g"}}') expecting {} (fail-first). Minor: unit-pass.log (07:21) is older than store.ts (07:26); my rerun passes so not blocking.
